title: First 300k Stability Trajectory and Trigger Playbook
summary: Roadmap tracker and operational playbook for the product activation window from first user to 300k requests/day. Focused on measurable KPIs, automated triggers for scaling and rollback, and on-call/owner playbook for incident triage.
purpose: Provide a concise, actionable sequence of KPIs, thresholds, and runbooks the ops and product teams use to guardrails rollout velocity while preserving latency and unit-cost targets across hosted/dedicated/private modes.
launch_scope: Pilot 0–10k DAU (internal beta) -> Ramp 10k–100k DAU (external beta) -> Scale 100k–300k DAU (open rollout). Include dedicated capacity planning, canary percentages, and model fallback policies.
kpi_definitions: p95_gen_latency_ms | <= 350ms | measured per route and model | owner: eng-serving-runtime
cost_per_1k_tokens_usd | target <= $0.22 | rolling 24h average | owner: product-ops
cold_start_rate | <= 0.5% | fraction of requests experiencing >1s cold start | owner: infra
thresholds_and_triggers: Green -> Amber: p95_gen_latency_ms > 350ms for 10m AND error_rate_5m > 0.4% -> notify oncall and throttle non-critical routes
Amber -> Red: sustained p95_gen_latency_ms > 450ms for 15m OR error_rate_5m > 1% -> auto-scale + enable fallback to smaller model variant
Cost spike trigger: cost_per_1k_tokens_usd increases by 30% vs baseline for 2 consecutive hours -> enable batching profiles + enable quantized variant for best-effort traffic
Capacity pressure: GPU queue length > 1200 across cluster AND avg GPU util > 92% -> allocate burst pool (dedicated) or divert traffic regionally
Onboarding rollback: new rollout >10% traffic and any of (p95 > 500ms, error_rate > 2%) within first 30m -> automated rollback to previous release
runbook_snippets: Immediate triage steps: 1) Snapshot current traffic split and active model versions; 2) Run quick health check script (health-check.sh) for host-level metrics; 3) If KV cache hit rate <25% attempt cache warm-up for top 5 prefixes
Fallback activation: flip routing policy to 'fallback-variant' (canary config id: fb-v1), reduce canary to 5% and divert 95% to stable model until p95 < 400ms
Scaling play: for dedicated pools, increase vGPU count by +20% via reserved-scaler; for hosted, enable auto-burst and scale-up policy 'fast-burst-3m'
Communication: page channel #prodops and escalate to senior eng if Red state persists >20m. Post-incident: fill incident template and attach to JIRA ticket
rollout_schedule: Week -4: Freeze core infra changes; run load tests at 0.5x expected peak
Week -2: Internal beta (pilot) 0->5% traffic, checklist signoffs from infra, sres, and product
Week 0: External beta ramp to 20% with daily metric reviews and SLO audits
Week 2-6: Incremental increases with gating at 25%, 50%, 75% based on automated acceptance criteria
Week 8+: Full open rollout to 100% with steady-state monitoring and weekly KPI reviews
capacity_plan: Baseline: reserve 80 vGPU-hours/day for pilot; plan add-on pools for ramp phases: +200 vGPU-hours/day at 100k, +600 vGPU-hours/day at 300k
Autoscaling rules: min nodes = 6, max nodes = 120, scale-out threshold = avg_gpu_util > 78% for 3m, scale-in threshold = avg_gpu_util < 35% for 10m
Burst strategy: maintain 12% buffer of capacity for 30-minute surge windows; pre-warm model caches before expected marketing events
stakeholder_signoffs: Product PM: Priya Patel -> feature readiness and acceptance criteria
SRE Lead: Marco Reyes -> SLOs, oncall roster verified
Security & Compliance: Aisha Khan -> private deployment checklist signed if enterprise beta
Head of Serving: Ethan Brooks -> model variant vetting and cost guardrails confirmed
risk_mitigations: Model regression: keep eval prompt set for top 50 intents; daily A/B quality checks when switching variants
Region loss: preconfigure cross-region routing with automatic fallback to secondary region and adherence to data residency requirements
Unexpected cost growth: circuit-breaker lambda to scale down non-critical routes and alert finance
oncall_quick_checklist: Confirm whether incident crosses SLOs and which traffic cohorts are affected
Execute safe rollback if rollout introduced change within last 60 minutes
Notify product & comms if user-visible degradation persists >30 minutes
acceptance_criteria: All routes p95_gen_latency_ms <= 350ms for 72h after each traffic jump
Error rate remains <0.8% across 24h rolling window
Cost per 1k tokens within +/- 15% of modeled forecast
No critical security or privacy flags in audits
post_launch_tasks: 72h stabilization review: owners submit metric snapshots and lessons learned
30d retrospective: traffic growth vs forecast, model quality regressions, and ops spend reconciliation
Update runbooks with any new triggers discovered during rollout
notes: This sheet is intentionally prescriptive for the 0->300k window. Use conservative gating for enterprise/regional customers. Keep the linked spreadsheet for live telemetry and the Confluence doc as the canonical narrative. If conflicting guidance exists, SRE lead takes emergency precedence for safety-related changes.
